replicaCount.description: Number of replicas; more than one sends every alert multiple times, which ntfy only collapses into one notification through the sequence ID.

hosts.description: Hostnames of mirrored AMCS MySQL databases. They take turns being polled, so each is polled once per interval, offset by an equal share of it.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Kubernetes Secret with the read-only MySQL username and password.

existingSecretUsernameKey.description: Key in the existing Secret that holds the MySQL username.

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Key in the existing Secret that holds the MySQL password.

url.description: Base URL of the ntfy server.

topic.description: ntfy topic to publish to. Public servers expose it to anyone who knows the name, so make it hard to guess.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Kubernetes Secret containing a ntfy access token.

existingSecretTokenKey.description: Key in the existing Secret that holds the ntfy access token.

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between polls of the alert tables.

pollTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds one poll of one mirror may take before it is abandoned. Keep well below livenessMaxAgeSeconds.

minPriority.description: Lowest AMCS priority that is forwarded.

attempts.description: Attempts to deliver a notification before giving up on it.

dryRun.description: Log notifications instead of sending them.

livenessPath.description: File touched after every poll; its age is what the liveness probe checks. Must be on a writable volume.

livenessMaxAgeSeconds.description: Age of the liveness file in seconds after which the container is restarted. Must exceed the retries of a single notification and pollTimeoutSeconds.

readinessPath.description: File created once polling is set up; its existence is what the readiness probe checks. Must be on a writable volume.

tag.description: Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for pulling images from a private registry.
